candidate_responsibility: Evaluate language models with automated metrics, factuality checks, judges, human agreement, statistics, and regressions.

dimensions.question: What responsibility the source contributes to this cluster.
Methods, phases, tools, or templates contributed by the source.
Inputs consumed and artifacts or decisions produced.
Rules, gates, evidence checks, and validation criteria.
Tools, mutation authority, external effects, and consent boundaries.
Known limitations, failure modes, and unsupported assumptions.

fusion_rules.rule: Evaluate language models with automated metrics, factuality checks, judges, human agreement, statistics, and regressions.
Accept only: Model outputs, references, criteria, annotations, and trusted historical baselines.
Produce only: Repeatable scores, grounded quality judgments, statistical confidence, benchmarks, and regression signals.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

Before processing customer, proprietary, recorded, or externally judged data, require authorization, minimization, redaction, retention, external-transfer boundary, and deletion policy; otherwise return needs-input or blocked.

input_boundary: Model outputs, references, criteria, annotations, and trusted historical baselines.
output_boundary: Repeatable scores, grounded quality judgments, statistical confidence, benchmarks, and regression signals.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: LLM 三维评测体系全景分类法：涵盖自动化指标（文本生成 BLEU/ROUGE/BERTScore、分类 F1/AUC、RAG 检索 MRR/NDCG）、人工专家评测（准确性、连贯性、相关性、流畅度、安全性、有益度）及 LLM-as-Judge（Pointwise/Pairwise/Reference-based/Reference-free）; 可扩展 EvaluationSuite 评测套件代码模板：通过封装 Metric 数据结构与异步 evaluate 执行流水线，并发驱动大模型预测并批量计算聚合均值与样本原始得分; 传统 NLP 与深度语义重合度指标实现规程：包含带平滑函数的 BLEU 翻译重合度、ROUGE 摘要召回 F1，以及基于 DeBERTa 预训练模型的 BERTScore 深度语义表征相似度计算
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 评估大语言模型系统质量时的多维度策略框架; 工程化集成多维指标进行批量模型推理打分; 针对标准参考答案计算字面与语义重合度
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 10 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (gate=1, method=4, rule=2, template=3); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 可扩展 EvaluationSuite 评测套件代码模板：通过封装 Metric 数据结构与异步 evaluate 执行流水线，并发驱动大模型预测并批量计算聚合均值与样本原始得分; 单回答 LLM-as-Judge 质量打分结构模板：借助 Pydantic QualityRating 强制模型输出 1-10 范围的准确性、有益性、清晰度评分以及强制性文字打分理由（Reasoning）; 双样本配对优选裁判模板（Pairwise Judge）：输入两个变体回答让大模型对比判定胜负（A/B/tie），输出决策分析与 1-10 置信度，消除绝对打分的尺度漂移
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 工程化集成多维指标进行批量模型推理打分; 无确定标准答案时的开放式大模型输出质量单点评审; 模型选型、Prompt 版本迭代优劣对比
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 3 source-grounded atom(s) for inputs-and-outputs (template=3); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 将文本蕴含置信度作为衡量幻觉的量化门禁; 提供 p-value 显著性判定与 Cohen's d 效应量规模定级（negligible/small/medium/large）; 准确识别相对跌幅超过 threshold 的指标并输出回归摘要清单
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: RAG 检索增强系统回答的忠实度与真实性核验; 严谨评定 A/B 实验优胜者的准则; 发布前持续集成门禁检查
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 3 source-grounded atom(s) for gates-and-validation (gate=1, rule=2); each is bound to an exact source citation.
